interface.shortDescription: Universal package manager, security auditor, and context token profiler for portable agent skills.
interface.longDescription: SkillForge is the universal package manager, security auditor, and context token profiler for portable AI agent skills (SKILL.md). It audits skills for prompt injections and hidden unicode, profiles turn-by-turn context token consumption, and synchronizes skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Google Antigravity, Windsurf, Cline, and GitHub Copilot.
